mail.lewis.title: A New Service in Town
mail.lewis.text: Dear @,^^I'm pleased to let you know that Pelican Town now has a small banking terminal inside my home. You may use it during normal visiting hours to manage savings or ask about a loan.^^Please be considerate of municipal business while you're there—and don't worry, the machine was placed where it won't get in anyone's way.^^I hope this new service helps your farm continue to prosper.^  -Mayor Lewis
